reviews.reason: Per-location PMC headshot ladders up to 200 duplicate contractor and precision domains; retain only bounded contextual precision constraints.
Per-location Scav headshot ladders up to 500 are farming templates; retain at most a bounded precision variation where an authored operation needs it.
Per-location PMC kill ladders up to 500 add count escalation but no new operational purpose.
A 1-to-100 Raider ladder is absorbed by the existing Labs security operation; no second progression chain.
A 1-to-100 Rogue ladder is absorbed by Lighthouse perimeter interdiction; location-free farming is rejected.
One-enemy/one-rig kill tasks are not standalone authored quests; only useful gear-restriction ideas may inform bounded expedition checks.
Helmet-by-helmet kill tasks are repetitive equipment mastery; preserve only meaningful protective field constraints.
Armor-set kill templates duplicate the authored protection domain; preserve only bounded combined-loadout constraints.
Headset-specific kill chains are gear quota progression; acoustic equipment may be a bounded condition, never a headset-by-headset ladder.

Specific-weapon elimination chains are already superseded by the seven-family Arsenal capability model. Use source coverage only to audit weapon-family pools; do not recreate per-weapon mastery quests.

proofGates: any future precision/gear modifier requires exact SPT 4.1.3 condition proof
any admitted target or equipment pool requires vanilla/Scorpion/Artem overlap review
Weapon Mastery may inform family coverage only and cannot increase frozen quest counts
do not change frozen 0.1.0 runtime quest or assort counts
